Kibble.Logging.MongoHandler module¶

MongoLogger derived class from Logger

class Kibble.Logging.MongoHandler.MongoHandler(db_name: str, host: str = 'database.internal', port: int = 27017, user: str = 'root', passwd: str = 'password', client: pymongo.MongoClient = None, update_frequency: float = 1.0)¶

Bases: Handler

Class for logging events/data to the MongoDB. Events go to a time series collection; devices use a normal collection.

close()¶

Tidy up any resources used by the handler.

This version removes the handler from an internal map of handlers, _handlers, which is used for handler lookup by name. Subclasses should ensure that this gets called from overridden close() methods.

emit(record)¶

Do whatever it takes to actually log the specified logging record.

This version is intended to be implemented by subclasses and so raises a NotImplementedError.
